settings.label: Enabled
settings.description:
Opens Netflix's own player full screen
Needs Chromium with Widevine (on the 240-MP OS image already)

settings.label: Catalogue Region
settings.description:
The country whose Netflix catalogue to list
Titles come from TMDB, which needs a free API key in tmdb_api_key.txt

settings.label: Catalogue Language
settings.description: The language of titles and genres in the catalogue

settings.label: Sign out
settings.description:
Forgets the Netflix sign-in on this player
The next visit asks for it again
